# Local Copilot Instructions (Example)

This file is an optional local override for contributors.
Copy this file to `.github/copilot-instructions.local.md` and customize as needed.
Do not commit the `.local` file.

## Purpose
- Keep personal preferences out of repository-shared instructions.
- Add machine-specific or user-specific workflow notes.

## Example Sections

### Personal Workflow Preferences
- Preferred branch workflow details.
- Local tooling preferences.
- Preferred review style.

### Local Environment Notes
- Local path and shell conventions.
- Local build or run notes not relevant to all contributors.

### Personal Identity and Access Notes
- Owner-only permissions and repository admin preferences.
- Personal commit identity reminders.
